meta.name: lead-capture
meta.description: Converts anonymous traffic into known contacts — lead magnets, gated content, free tools, popups, and the forms behind them. Use this to design or improve a lead magnet, plan a free tool, add or fix popups and overlays, improve form conversion, or decide what is worth gating and what should stay open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计诱饵与门槛,把匿名访客变成留资线索,提升表单和弹窗转化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站有访客但缺少留资方式,想用诱饵、弹窗和表单把匿名流量变成销售线索。
copy.tagline_en: Design lead magnets and forms to turn anonymous traffic into contacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want to capture leads through popups and forms.

howto.what: Claude 会就如何把匿名访客转化为已知联系人给出建议,涵盖电子铅磁铁、免费工具、弹窗与表单的设计和优化,并提醒哪些内容值得设置门槛。
howto.when: 当你想设计或改进电子铅磁铁、规划免费工具,或处理弹窗、表单及内容设门槛问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个模板型电子铅磁铁
say.note: Claude会判断它是否值得用来换邮箱

say.text: 弹窗应该什么时候出现?
say.note: Claude会建议按行为触发而非时间

say.text: 这个下载表单该收集哪些信息?
say.note: Claude会提醒每多一个字段都会掉转化

howto.what_en: Claude advises on turning anonymous visitors into known contacts — covering lead magnets, free tools, popups, and forms, and advising on what to gate.
howto.when_en: When asked to design or improve lead magnets, plan free tools, or handle popups, forms, and gating.

say_en.text: Help me design a template-style lead magnet.
say_en.note: Claude will judge whether it earns an email.
Claude suggests behavior-based triggers, not time.

say_en.text: What fields should my download form ask for?
say_en.note: Claude notes each field costs conversion.
